description: SIM96 — CMSTG RSD / f·sigma_8 Growth Rate. Tests CMSTG against redshift-space distortion (RSD) measurements from 6dFGRS, SDSS MGS, BOSS DR12, VIPERS, and eBOSS DR16 (9 gold-sample data points, z=0.067–1.48). CMSTG modifies the effective gravitational constant G_eff(Psi), suppressing the linear growth rate f = d ln D / d ln a and hence f·sigma_8. Tests: (1) chi2 fit CMSTG vs LCDM at joint best-fit; (2) Lambda0 scan for f·sigma_8 deviation; (3) Compare CMSTG-predicted sigma_8 tension with current KiDS/DES tension.
note_sigma8: Linear sigma_8 at z=0 from SIM90 joint best-fit cosmology (H0=67.59, Omega_m=0.312). Confirmed by SIM92.
note_data: Gold-sample RSD compilation. BOSS DR12 and eBOSS DR16 covariance: BOSS DR12 bins are correlated (off-diagonal ~0.4–0.5 from Alam+2017 Table 9). For chi2 we use the diagonal approximation; a note flags this for future work.

lambda0_scan.note: Scan Lambda0 to find detection threshold in f·sigma_8. At SIM91 result: H(z) dev <0.03% at Lambda0=0.1, growth dev >0.1% at Lambda0>=0.05.

acceptance.note: PASS if chi2/dof < 2.5 at joint best-fit; CMSTG/LCDM f·sigma_8 deviation < 1% at Lambda0=0.008.
